name: Jezreel (Hosea's son)
title: The Prophet's Symbolic Son
summary: Jezreel was the firstborn son of the prophet Hosea and his wife Gomer. His name, meaning 'God sows' or 'God scatters,' served as a prophetic message about God's coming judgment on the house of Jehu for the bloodshed in the Valley of Jezreel, but also as a promise of future restoration.

keyEvents.title: Naming as a Prophetic Sign
keyEvents.description: God commanded Hosea to name his son Jezreel as a sign that God would soon punish the house of Jehu for the bloodshed in the Valley of Jezreel.

keyEvents.title: A Symbol of Israel's Judgment
keyEvents.description: Jezreel's name pointed to the coming judgment on the kingdom of Israel, where God would break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel.

keyEvents.title: Promise of Restoration
keyEvents.description: Despite the judgment, the name also contains a hope for future restoration, where 'the day of Jezreel' will be great and the people will once again be united under one leader.

keyEvents.title: Part of the family's prophetic message
keyEvents.description: Together with his siblings Lo-Ruhama and Lo-Ammi, Jezreel formed a living prophetic illustration of God's relationship with Israel.
